checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same woman at kitchen table throughout
must.why: Same woman and kitchen in all frames.

must.item: Subtitles cover complete sentence without omissions
must.why: Frame at 1s shows no 'Hi everyone!' subtitle (could be timing); the rest appears present but 'Hi everyone!' not seen.

must.item: Subtitle chunks appear with corresponding speech
must.why: Chunks appear in segments (two chunks seen at 4.1s and 7.1s), not the full transcript at once.

must.item: Readable, inside frame, not covering face
must.why: White bold text sits at the chest level, within frame, though with weak contrast against the light sweater and no outline; the face is uncovered.

must.item: Original speech audible and framing preserved
must.why: Audio has sound at a normal peak level and the framing looks the same, but the speech cannot be judged. Duration 10.1s.

exact_text.read_as: No subtitle visible at 1s; may be absent or between frames

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy
'three easy' on one line and 'ways' on the next; the phrase is split across chunks

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your mornings less stressful. (split across chunks; text itself is correct)

faults.what: White text with no outline or shadow has poor contrast over the light grey sweater, so parts of the subtitle are hard to read.
'Hi everyone!' subtitle not visible at 1s and 9.6s frames; possibly missing the opening greeting.
The subtitle sits over the chest and hands area, mid-frame rather than at the very bottom; the claimed 'bottom center' is partly true.
The chunk split puts 'three easy' / 'ways' on different lines.

summary: The subtitles are burned in with correct English text and good timing, and the woman and framing are unchanged, but contrast against the light sweater is poor and the opening 'Hi everyone!' was not seen.
